questions.prompt: Earth turns through 360° in 24 hours. How many degrees does it turn in one hour?
questions.explain: 360 ÷ 24 = 15° per hour. This is the basis of time zones.

questions.prompt: Plan an investigation to record how a shadow changes during a school day, using a stick in the ground.

Every hour from 8 am to 4 pm, mark the tip of the shadow with a pebble and measure the shadow length with a measuring tape; note the direction with a compass. Keep the same stick and position, measure at the same minute past each hour, and choose a sunny day. Plot shadow length against time and draw the direction on a map.
